answer_1.quote: this paper releases a new Machine Translation Gender Evaluation benchmark: MT-GenEval. MT-GenEval focuses on the task of gender accuracy in translation.

answer_2.quote: To automatically evaluate gender accuracy in translation on this set, we propose a straightforward accuracy metric ... We define accuracy of gender in translation ... We complement the accuracy metric with a gender quality gap metric, ∆ qual ... where BLEU gender is the BLEU score ...

answer_4.quote: We asked two professional translators to judge gender accuracy in context ... We used human evaluations to measure the gender accuracy ...
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were asked to judge gender accuracy of the translation of the main sentence in context.
